# MediaPipe assets

- SDK: Google MediaPipe `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` **0.10.32**, Apache-2.0. See LICENSE.
- Package source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/0.10.32
- Face Landmarker model revision: `face_landmarker/float16/1/face_landmarker.task` from Google's model distribution. Source URL and SHA-256 are in manifest.json.
- Model documentation: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/face_landmarker
- Upstream source: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe

Files are unmodified vendored assets, served from the same origin. The package tarball's SHA-512 integrity was checked before extraction. All SDK/model file SHA-256 values are tested in tests/vision-assets.test.mjs. No package installation or model download is performed at build time. Face frames are not sent to the model publisher.
